description: This file defines types, default policies, and functions related to transcript policies and provider replay policies in a plugin-based architecture for AI model interactions.

methods.name: isAnthropicApi
methods.description: Checks if the given model API string corresponds to an Anthropic API.

methods.name: buildUnownedProviderTransportReplayFallback
methods.description: Builds a fallback replay policy for providers without a dedicated runtime plugin, based on model API type.

methods.name: mergeTranscriptPolicy
methods.description: Merges a given provider replay policy with a base transcript policy, filling in defaults.

methods.name: resolveTranscriptPolicy
methods.description: Resolves and constructs a transcript policy based on provider, model, and environment parameters.
